tier_classification.rationale: All five invariants are Hard-class; rollback operations mutate live system state and touch the lineage ledger. GovernanceGate preflight enforces invariant compliance before any state change can proceed.

invariants.description: Every rollback operation MUST pass GovernanceGate preflight validation against all active Hard-class invariants before execution.
A ROLLBACK_EVENT entry MUST be written to the lineage ledger prior to any state mutation.
Rollback execution is atomic: partial rollbacks are constitutionally prohibited. Either the full target state is restored or no state changes occur.
Rollback digest computation MUST exclude timestamps and non-deterministic fields. Given identical inputs the digest MUST be reproducible.
Rollback to any state predating the current HUMAN-0 governance epoch requires explicit HUMAN-0 ratification. Autonomous rollback is limited to the current epoch.
